title: ¡Tito no quiere brócoli! 🥦🐘 | #shorts
world: jungle picnic: a picnic blanket in a sunny jungle clearing with big tropical leaves, orange flowers and a little waterfall + a pretend forest of giant broccoli trees
story: Extreme close-up: Tito turns his face away from a broccoli floret, trunk curled, pouting: no, no, no! (refusal in second 0)
Mamá holds up the broccoli floret next to a real tree behind her: it looks like a little tree (the trick)
Wide: in pretend play Tito is a GIANT walking through a forest of broccoli trees (twist: imagination)
Low angle: giant Tito picks a broccoli tree with his trunk and takes a bite, crunch (he tries)
Back at the picnic: Tito chews with big delighted eyes (he likes it)
Top-down: Tito's trunk reaches for more broccoli on the plate (more, please)
Tito lifts a big round watermelon over his head with his trunk, proud and strong (reward + moral)
Mamá holds up an orange carrot; Tito's eyes go wide (loop gag: what now?)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡No, no, no! ¡Brócoli no!
[Verse]
Mamá dice: ¡son arbolitos!
¡Y Tito es un gigante!
¡Ñam! ¡Un arbolito!
¡Crunch, crunch! ¡Qué rico!
[Chorus]
¡Más arbolitos, por favor!
¡Fuerte, fuerte como un elefante!
[Outro]
¿Y zanahorias? ¡Uy!

locations.picnic: A sunny jungle clearing outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a soft blue-and-white checkered picnic blanket on green grass, a little wooden basket, big glossy tropical leaves, bright orange jungle flowers, a small sparkling waterfall in the background, warm sunlight through the leaves. Nobody is in the clearing.
locations.bosque: A playful pretend forest outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a forest of giant broccoli trees with thick pale-green stalks and round fluffy dark-green tops, soft green grass, a few giant orange carrot plants, a bright blue sky with white clouds. Nobody is in the forest.

shots: Extreme close-up of the baby elephant's face at the jungle picnic: he turns his face away from a small green broccoli floret held near him, his eyes squeezed shut, his trunk curled up tightly, pouting, big tropical leaves blurred behind.
He turns his head further away from the broccoli and shakes it slowly.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind the baby elephant on the picnic blanket: Mamá Elefanta smiling holds up one small broccoli floret in her trunk right next to a real green jungle tree behind her, the floret looking exactly like a tiny tree.
Mamá lifts the broccoli floret beside the tree and smiles; the baby elephant tilts his head.

Wide shot of the pretend broccoli forest: the baby elephant now GIANT-sized, as tall as the giant broccoli trees, walks happily between the round fluffy dark-green broccoli treetops, giant orange carrot plants around his feet.
The giant baby elephant walks slowly between the broccoli trees, happy.
Low angle from the grass looking up: the GIANT baby elephant holds one broccoli tree in his trunk and takes a big bite of its round fluffy green top, little green crumbs falling, blue sky behind.
He takes a big bite of the broccoli treetop and little green crumbs fall.

Close-up three-quarter view at the jungle picnic: the baby elephant, normal size again, chews with his mouth closed and his eyes wide open with delight, a small broccoli floret in his trunk, orange flowers blurred behind.
He chews happily and his eyes grow wide with delight.
Top-down view from above the picnic blanket: a white plate with small broccoli florets on the blue-and-white checkered blanket, and the baby elephant's trunk reaching in to take one more floret.
His trunk reaches in and picks up one more broccoli floret.

Medium shot, side view on the picnic blanket: the baby elephant proudly lifts a big round green watermelon high above his head with his trunk, standing tall and strong, Mamá Elefanta clapping beside him.
He lifts the watermelon up high and Mamá claps happily.
Close-up from the front at the picnic: Mamá Elefanta's trunk holds up a bright orange carrot in front of the baby elephant, whose eyes go wide in surprise, his trunk tip curling into a question mark.
The carrot wiggles in front of him and his eyes go wide.
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.
twist: Mamá's idea 'they are little trees' turns into a pretend world where Tito is a GIANT eating a broccoli forest — the refusal becomes play
moral: ¡Las verduras te hacen fuerte, fuerte como un elefante!
experiment: first pretend/imagination location (a giant in a broccoli forest) — the location change IS the twist; healthy-food refusal topic (Doctora Sophia veggie videos ×29–×209)
continuity: sunny daytime in every shot; Tito normal size at the picnic (B1-B2, B5-B8), GIANT only in the broccoli forest (B3-B4); yellow overalls always; checkered blanket in every picnic shot; Mamá in B2, B7, B8; broccoli floret B1-B2, B5-B6; watermelon only B7; carrot only B8
